footnotes: Ĉ indicates two cysteines joined by disulphide bond. Alanin residues replacing W10 and W20 are underlined.

tables.label: Table 2
tables.caption: Minimal inhibitory concentration (µM) of the NCR peptide fragments against Candida strains.
footnotes: -: no growth inhibition was observed. Ca: Candida albicans, Cau: Candida auris, Cg: Candida glabrata, Cp: Candida parapsilosis, Ct: Candida tropicalis.

tables.label: Table 3
tables.caption: Combined activity of NCR peptide derivatives and fluconazole.
footnotes: Fractional inhibitory concentration (FIC) index values: ≤0.5: synergism; 0.5 < FIC ≤ 1.0: additive; 1.0 < FIC ≤ 2.0: indifferent; >2: antagonism. (µM) corresponds to the concentration of drug A and Drug B for the indicated action. * represents a fictitious FIC value which could be lower as NCR335C17–33 was inactive against C. auris at 25 µM nevertheless 25 µM was used as MIC for the calculation of FIC.
